== Main Success Scenario

// Each step has a semantic anchor with the FULL STEP TEXT as the reftext.
// Format: [[stable-anchor,Full Human Readable Step Text]]
// This gives humans clickable links showing the full phrase,
// while AIs/tools can use the stable anchor ID.

. [[step-initiate,{step-1-text}]] *{step-1-text}* +
  _{step-1-result}_

. [[step-authenticate,{step-2-text}]] *{step-2-text}* +
  _{step-2-result}_

. [[step-validate,{step-3-text}]] *{step-3-text}* +
  _{step-3-result}_

. [[step-create,{step-4-text}]] *{step-4-text}* +
  _{step-4-result}_

. [[step-complete,{step-5-text}]] *{step-5-text}* +
  _{step-5-result}_

== Extensions (Alternative Flows)

// Extensions reference steps using <<anchor>> syntax.
// The rendered link will show the full step text, not the anchor ID.
// Example: <<step-validate>> renders as "System validates identity is new"

=== At <<step-validate>>: {extension-1-name}

*Condition:* {extension-1-condition}

*Steps:*
. {extension-1-step-1}
. {extension-1-step-2}
. *Resume:* Return to <<step-create>> (or <<step-complete>>, or *ENDS*)

=== At <<step-{unique-id}-3>>: {extension-2-name}

*Condition:* {extension-2-condition}

*Steps:*
. {extension-2-step-1}
. {extension-2-step-2}
. *Resume:* Return to <<step-{unique-id}-4>>

== Example: Semantic vs Numeric References

=== BAD (Numeric - breaks when reordered)
----
Main:
1. User enters credentials
2. System validates user      <- becomes step 3
3. System displays dashboard  <- becomes step 4

Extensions:
2a. Invalid credentials       <- MUST update to 3a
3a. Account locked            <- MUST update to 4a
----

=== GOOD (Semantic - survives reordering)
----
Main:
[#step-enter-creds]
1. User enters credentials
[#step-validate-user]
2. System validates user      <- still "step-validate-user"
[#step-display-dashboard]
3. System displays dashboard  <- still "step-display-dashboard"

Extensions:
=== At <<step-validate-user>>: Invalid credentials  <- no change needed
=== At <<step-display-dashboard>>: Account locked   <- no change needed
----
